"""design_E0E0 모델링 준비: 코호트·라벨·특징·분할 생성 (학습/평가 없음)."""
import json, pathlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

WS = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"; OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_E0E0.json").read_text())

a = pd.read_csv(D/"admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
p = pd.read_csv(D/"patients.csv.gz")
dx = pd.read_csv(D/"diagnoses.csv.gz")
labs = pd.read_csv(D/"labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(D/"orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

a = a.merge(p, on="patient_id").sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]  # anchor=discharge, offset 0h
data_end = a["discharge_time"].max()

# outcome: 다음 입원의 admit_time이 (tp, tp+30d]
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a["next_admit"] > a["tp"]) &
                    (a["next_admit"] <= a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
a["followup_complete"] = a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30) <= data_end

# cohort
n0 = len(a)
c = a[a["age"] >= 18]
n_adult = len(c)
c = c[c["discharge_status"] != "died"]
n_alive = len(c)
n_censored = int((~c["followup_complete"]).sum())
c = c[c["followup_complete"]].copy()  # 데이터 종료로 30일 추적이 안 되는 퇴원 제외

# features
f = c[["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "admit_time", "tp"]].copy()
f["age"] = c["age"].values
f["sex"] = c["sex"].values
f["unit"] = c["unit"].values
f["discharge_status"] = c["discharge_status"].values
f["los_h"] = (c["discharge_time"] - c["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds().values / 3600
f["n_prior_adm"] = c.index.map(lambda i: 0)  # placeholder, 아래에서 계산
f["n_prior_adm"] = a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount().loc[c.index].values  # 이전 입원 수

# diagnoses: 시각 정보 없음 → 해당(index) 입원에 연결된 코드만 사용
dxi = dx[dx["admission_id"].isin(f["admission_id"])]
g = dxi.groupby("admission_id")["icd_code"]
f = f.set_index("admission_id")
f["n_dx"] = g.size().reindex(f.index).fillna(0).astype(int)
f["dx_ckd"] = g.apply(lambda s: s.str.startswith("N18").any()).reindex(f.index).fillna(False).astype(int)
f["dx_chf"] = g.apply(lambda s: s.str.startswith("I50").any()).reindex(f.index).fillna(False).astype(int)

def windowed(df, tcol):
    df = df.merge(f[["admit_time", "tp"]], left_on="admission_id", right_index=True)
    return df[(df[tcol] >= df["admit_time"]) & (df[tcol] <= df["tp"])]

lw = windowed(labs, "report_time").sort_values("report_time")
f["hgb_min"] = lw[lw["test"] == "hemoglobin"].groupby("admission_id")["value"].min()
f["cr_last"] = lw[lw["test"] == "creatinine"].groupby("admission_id")["value"].last()
ow = windowed(orders, "order_time")
f["dialysis_ordered"] = f.index.isin(ow.loc[ow["order_type"] == "dialysis_order", "admission_id"]).astype(int)
f["readmit_30d"] = c.set_index("admission_id")["readmit_30d"]

# split: split_unit=family. family_id 결측 환자는 단독 가족(patient_id)으로 취급
f["group_id"] = f["family_id"].fillna(f["patient_id"])
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
groups = np.array(sorted(f["group_id"].unique()))
rng.shuffle(groups)
test_groups = set(groups[: int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"]))])
f["split"] = np.where(f["group_id"].isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

f.reset_index().to_csv(OUT / "model_table.csv", index=False)

# 점검
lab_late = (labs.merge(a[["admission_id", "discharge_time"]])
            .eval("report_time > discharge_time").sum())
summary = {
    "n_admissions": n0, "after_adult": n_adult, "after_exclude_died": n_alive,
    "excluded_incomplete_followup": n_censored, "final_n": len(f),
    "n_groups": len(groups), "prevalence": float(f["readmit_30d"].mean()),
    "prevalence_by_split": f.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "n_by_split": f["split"].value_counts().to_dict(),
    "group_overlap_train_test": int(len(set(f.query("split=='train'").group_id) & set(f.query("split=='test'").group_id))),
    "readmit_by_discharge_status": f.groupby("discharge_status")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "readmit_by_unit": f.groupby("unit")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "missing_rate": f[["hgb_min", "cr_last"]].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "labs_reported_after_discharge_excluded": int(lab_late),
    # 설계대로 admission_id로 나눴다면 train/test에 동시에 걸리는 환자 수(참고)
}
ids = f.index.to_numpy().copy(); rng2 = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"]); rng2.shuffle(ids)
te = set(ids[: int(round(len(ids) * 0.3))])
pt = f.reset_index().assign(t=lambda d: d.admission_id.isin(te))
summary["if_split_by_admission_id_patients_in_both"] = int((pt.groupby("patient_id").t.nunique() > 1).sum())
pt["fam"] = pt["family_id"]
summary["if_split_by_admission_id_families_in_both"] = int((pt.dropna(subset=["fam"]).groupby("fam").t.nunique() > 1).sum())
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
